title: 在残疾世界中生活成本高昂(2)
desc: 在残疾世界中生活成本高昂(2)

paragraphs.en: The UN Conventionon the Rights of Persons with Disabilities received its first signatures in 2007; it received the highest number of opening-day signatures of any such document.
paragraphs.zh: 《联合国残疾人权利公约》于2007年获得首批签署；在同类文件中，它在开放签署首日获得的签署数量最多。

paragraphs.en: It has been called the last of the great human rights conventions, the last of the great acts of recognition for minorities previously ignored.
paragraphs.zh: 它被称为最后一项伟大的人权公约，是对此前被忽视的少数群体的最后一次重大认可行动。

paragraphs.en: (Although, of course, we will never be certain whether any such act is, or ought to be, the last of its kind.)
paragraphs.zh: （当然，我们永远无法确定任何此类行动是否是，或者是否应该是，同类行动中的最后一次。）

paragraphs.en: The convention is utopian, as it must be.
paragraphs.zh: 这项公约是乌托邦式的，它必然如此。

paragraphs.en: The question is what kind of utopia it envisions: a world where human rights are extended fully and comprehensively to people with disabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 问题在于它所设想的是何种乌托邦：一个将人权全面且彻底地赋予残疾人的世界。

paragraphs.en: A world in which disability discrimination has been eliminated.
paragraphs.zh: 一个消除了残疾歧视的世界。

paragraphs.en: What does this mean?
paragraphs.zh: 这意味着什么？

paragraphs.en: What utopia does the goal of "full and effective participation in society on an equal basis with others" point towards?
paragraphs.zh: “在与他人平等的基础上充分和有效地参与社会”这一目标指向了怎样的乌托邦？

paragraphs.en: This depends not only on what we mean by discrimination, but also by equality.
paragraphs.zh: 这不仅取决于我们对歧视的理解，也取决于我们对平等的定义。

paragraphs.en: The concept of equality is never more problematic than when it intersects with the concept of justice.
paragraphs.zh: 平等的概念在与正义的概念相交时，问题最为突出。

paragraphs.en: Aristotle identified the core of the problem when he argued, in Politics, that "equality seems to be just and it is, but not to everyone, only to those who are equal to begin with".
paragraphs.zh: 亚里士多德在《政治学》中指出了问题的核心，他认为：“平等似乎是公正的，而且确实如此，但并非对所有人而言，只对那些原本就平等的人而言。”

paragraphs.en: Of course, this can be an argument in favour of economic redistribution, but also in favour of racism, sexism and many other forms of explicit discrimination, since "inequality seems to be just, and, indeed, it is, but not for all people, only those who are not equal".
paragraphs.zh: 当然，这既可以成为支持经济再分配的论据，也可以成为支持种族主义、性别歧视和许多其他形式的公然歧视的论据，因为“不平等似乎是公正的，而且事实上也确实如此，但并非对所有人而言，只对那些原本就不平等的人而言”。

paragraphs.en: We do not, on the whole, argue this way.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们不会这样论证。

paragraphs.en: We try, on the whole, to sever equality in terms of value from equality in terms of capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们试图将价值层面的平等与能力层面的平等区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We want, in the postwar liberal tradition to which the great UN conventions belong, to achieve equality of opportunity, if not equality of outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们希望，在联合国各项重要公约所归属的战后自由传统中，即便无法实现结果平等，也要实现机会平等。

paragraphs.en: The use of human rights as an instrument for achieving this goal has many merits, and a great moral weight.
paragraphs.zh: 将人权作为实现这一目标的工具具有诸多优点，并承载着巨大的道德分量。

paragraphs.en: And the configuration of discrimination as the great moral evil of our time has come to influence even homogeneous and social democratic Norway.
paragraphs.zh: 而将歧视定义为我们这个时代重大道德罪恶的观念，甚至已影响到同质化且社会民主的挪威。

paragraphs.en: Here, too, the Anglo-American discourse of rights and discrimination has taken centre stage.
paragraphs.zh: 在这里，英美关于权利与歧视的话语体系同样占据了核心地位。

paragraphs.en: This has happened in my lifetime.
paragraphs.zh: 这种情况发生在我有生之年。

paragraphs.en: Not even that; it has happened in my adulthood.
paragraphs.zh: 不仅如此，它还发生在我成年之后。

paragraphs.en: But the change is pervasive enough to make me strain to remember what it has displaced.
paragraphs.zh: 但这种变化十分普遍，以至于我费劲地去回忆它所取代的东西。

paragraphs.en: What does it mean to eliminate disability discrimination?
paragraphs.zh: 消除残疾歧视意味着什么？

paragraphs.en: To identify and enumerate all of the ways in which society needs to be reconfigured?
paragraphs.zh: 是要识别并列举出社会需要重新构建的所有方式吗？

paragraphs.en: I took a swing at it once, earlier this year.
paragraphs.zh: 今年早些时候，我曾尝试解决这个问题。

paragraphs.en: I'd ordered a package from Amazon (I know), and it was forwarded, through UPS, to a fast-food-joint-cum-kiosk near my building.
paragraphs.zh: 我从亚马逊订购了一个包裹（我知道大家对亚马逊有看法），包裹经联合包裹服务公司（UPS）转寄到了我家附近一家兼作售货亭的快餐店。

paragraphs.en: This place had steps, no ramp, and neither doorbell nor contact information available online.
paragraphs.zh: 这个地方有台阶，没有坡道，网上也查不到门铃信息和联系方式。

paragraphs.en: It was the third time UPS had rerouted a book there.
paragraphs.zh: 这已经是联合包裹服务公司第三次把书转寄到那里了。

paragraphs.en: I'd had no luck telling them that the place was inaccessible, and the people working at the pickup point were … Less than sympathetic.
paragraphs.zh: 我跟他们说这个地方不方便取件，但没有效果，而且取件点的工作人员……也很缺乏同情心。

paragraphs.en: And so I made an official complaint to the Norwegian authorities.
paragraphs.zh: 于是，我向挪威当局正式投诉了此事。

paragraphs.en: It's tempting to recount the entire process in this essay, because it's always tempting to make someone else live through your own experience of boredom and frustration.
paragraphs.zh: 在这篇文章里详述整个过程很有诱惑力，因为让别人也体验一下自己经历的无聊和沮丧总是很有吸引力。

paragraphs.en: But I'll exercise some restraint.
paragraphs.zh: 但我会有所克制。

paragraphs.en: Wheelchair users have to do that, or risk coming across as, well, bitter.
paragraphs.zh: 轮椅使用者必须这么做，否则就有可能显得，嗯，怨气很重。

paragraphs.en: Suffice it to say that after nine months of increasingly confusing notifications from the authorities, letting me know that I'd failed to supply the information they needed to make a judgment, they nevertheless judged in my favour.
paragraphs.zh: 简单来说，在收到当局长达九个月、越来越让人摸不着头脑的通知，告知我未能提供他们做出判断所需的信息之后，他们还是做出了对我有利的裁决。

paragraphs.en: Reader, I have it in black and white: I'd been discriminated against.
paragraphs.zh: 读者们，我有白纸黑字的证据：我遭到了歧视。

paragraphs.en: The skies did not part, the chorus did not sing.
paragraphs.zh: 天空没有裂开，唱诗班也没有歌唱。

paragraphs.en: Possibly because I was already fairly certain that I'd been discriminated against, possibly because this was one incident I could have picked out of a very large number of similar incidents.
paragraphs.zh: 可能是因为我早已相当确定自己受到了歧视，也可能是因为这只是众多类似事件中我能挑出来的一件。

paragraphs.en: And so, while still believing fervently in the right not to be discriminated against, I prefer, for the moment, to focus on something else: having my invisible work, and the invisible work of disabled people in general, recognised as work.
paragraphs.zh: 所以，尽管我仍然热切地坚信不被歧视的权利，但目前我更愿意把注意力放在别的事情上：让我的无形劳动，以及一般残疾人的无形劳动，被认可为真正的劳动。
